$comment: Hand-ruled QA cells from the archived phase-6 LOG (D498, via D493/D495): the 6 standing gate-FAIL deviations accepted inside their inherited history (or as loading-animation phase), plus the 5 out-of-range acceptances below the floor (4) and above the old ceiling (barloading hover-30). A ruled cell with px <= bound reads `ruled (<D>)` instead of FAIL and is excluded from issues. Raising a bound or adding a cell needs a D-entry. D607 (A11, closing) retires the three barloading bounds set from pre-anchor history: hover-30 is unruled (reads 111-1565, under the 4800 gate) and hover-50/hover-70 drop 53588/33734 to 16000 each, sized on the four runs since the D588 virtual-time budget. barloading/100/settled is deliberately NOT ruled: it reads a stable ~21600 px every run, which is a reproducible difference to find, not phase noise. In-range PASS cells named in D498 (markers legend-hover-0/1/clear, scatter/scattermultiaxis hover-70) need no ruling; the D407 choropleth race was a single event on a cell that reads 0. V4.4.
